verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Honcho's core is open source at github.com/plastic-labs/honcho and can be self-hosted, and llms.txt describes it as an open-source memory layer, so users can read the core source. The docs qualify only the "core" as open, though, and no specific license is named, so the full openness and licensing terms are unproven. missing for 10: named open license (e.g., SPDX identifier or LICENSE file evidence), confirmation that components beyond the core are open, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The core is open source at github.com/plastic-labs/honcho, so you can run the whole thing yourself and keep your data on your own infrastructure.
Honcho is an open-source memory layer for AI agents, built by Plastic Labs.
